test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the bracket to fill in the blank.

I can’t forget the (convivial)___________ atmosphere at the college reunion.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2' i.e. 'Antisocial'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Convivial"** refers to an atmosphere or event that is friendly, lively, and enjoyable. It means 'cheerful and friendly';(आनंदित)

 
 
• **Example:** The party was convivial and everyone enjoyed it.
 
 
 
• The word** "Antisocial" **refers to a person who avoids socializing or is unfriendly. It is the opposite of 'convivial'.(असामाजिक)
 
 
• **Example:** He was being antisocial and refused to attend the party.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is - 'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"Affable" **means friendly, good-natured, or easy to talk to.(मिलनसार)
 
• Option 3, **"Hospitable" **means friendly and welcoming to visitors or guests.(मेहमान नवाज़).
 
• Option 4**, "Lively"** means full of life and energy; active and outgoing. (जीवंत)
